run_extract_file: extract a specific file from a ZIP archive to a target directory using extract_file
run_process_func: process VASP relaxation trajectories in parallel to extract final potential energies from vasprun.xml files
run_get_energies_main: run the script with an ID argument to extract energies from all subdirectories in temp_download
refactor_process_func: refactor process_func to support additional trajectory formats beyond VASP XML for energy extraction
review_extract_file: review extract_file to add error handling for missing or corrupted ZIP archives
